feedback: Cary's confession follows the decisive pre-vote contradiction exactly: the crest glass was used, and his spare-glass story tried to break that evidence chain. Stealing poison during the preview and adding it later supplies the particular sequence, but those are confirmations of an available route rather than new facts needed to identify him. The clarification that the packing bin concerned frame damage usefully preserves the distinction between his two concealments. His fear of losing work and the final recognition of a larger loss make the admission emotionally credible. Chip and Barb's consequences also feel earned, though all three speakers remain unusually articulate about what their mistakes mean. The finale resolves the case without substituting a surprise forensic discovery.
